You can switch by pressing the right mouse button, and shoot the beads by clicking the left button. The colored beads move forward along a fixed track. The closer to the end of the track "Golden Skull", the slower the beads move forward. Players need to shoot the beads so that 3 or more beads on the track collide to cause elimination, and prevent the beads from falling into the mouth of the golden skull. If the shooting causes the bead string to be interrupted, and the two ends of the interruption are beads of the same color, the first half will retreat and collide with the second half.
